description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing and retrieving loan capitalized income data within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for fetching capitalized income details, amortization data, and related allocations by loan ID or external ID, with support for various query parameters.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing loan capitalized income data, including fetching details and allocations by loan ID or external ID.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeData
methods.description: Fetches capitalized income data for a specific loan by loan ID.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeDataByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches capitalized income data for a loan identified by external ID.

methods.name: fetchCapitalizedIncomeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed capitalized income entries for a specific loan.

methods.name: fetchCapitalizedIncomeDetailsByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves detailed capitalized income entries for a loan identified by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveCapitalizedIncomeAllocationData
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve capitalized income allocation data based on various identifiers and query parameters.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomeAllocationDataByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves capitalized income allocation data using loan external ID and transaction ID.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomeAllocationDataByTransactionExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves capitalized income allocation data using loan ID and transaction external ID.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomeAllocationDataByExternalIds
methods.description: Retrieves capitalized income allocation data using external IDs for both loan and transaction.
